meta.title: Harvard i-lab Problem Landscape
meta.privacy: Aggregate cells only; cells below 10 observations are suppressed.

concepts.label: Effective therapies for underserved diseases
concepts.description: Patients and care systems lack sufficiently effective, tolerable, or durable treatments for serious diseases.
concepts.qualityNote: Broad health feature; overlaps the cancer-specific feature.

concepts.label: Inclusive consumer goods and personal expression
concepts.description: Consumers—often women or underserved identity groups—struggle to find products that fit their bodies, values, culture, or self-expression.
concepts.qualityNote: Some moderate activations are outside consumer goods.

concepts.label: Creative careers and arts education
concepts.description: Artists, creators, and students lack access to arts learning, mentorship, career pathways, and sustainable creative communities.
concepts.qualityNote: Coherent strongest activations; broader moderate tail.

concepts.label: Social connection and loneliness
concepts.description: People across life stages struggle to form meaningful relationships, maintain connection, and avoid isolation.
concepts.qualityNote: Includes friendship, dating, caregiving, and community participation.

concepts.label: Clean energy and built-environment transition
concepts.description: Property owners, tenants, businesses, and infrastructure operators face barriers to adopting cleaner energy and improving buildings.
concepts.qualityNote: Some financial-access overlap in moderate activations.

concepts.label: Workforce access, hiring, and career mobility
concepts.description: Job seekers and employers struggle to connect, build inclusive pipelines, hire effectively, and sustain a healthy workforce.
concepts.qualityNote: Includes college-to-career pathways and employee wellbeing.

concepts.label: Healthy and culturally relevant food
concepts.description: Consumers and families lack convenient, healthy, culturally resonant, or diet-appropriate food options.
concepts.qualityNote: Agricultural production appears in the moderate tail.

concepts.label: Equitable K–12 learning and student support
concepts.description: Schools, teachers, and families struggle to provide engaging, equitable learning and whole-student support.
concepts.qualityNote: Strong demand-side coherence.

concepts.label: Safer clinical procedures and hospital care
concepts.description: Patients and clinical teams face avoidable risks, complications, delays, and burdens around procedures and hospital care.
concepts.qualityNote: Strong HLS concentration; overlaps broad patient-care features.

concepts.label: Language access and English learning
concepts.description: Learners and service users face communication barriers because effective language learning and multilingual access are limited.
concepts.qualityNote: Strongest activations are coherent; moderate activations broaden.

concepts.label: Safer, more effective cancer treatment
concepts.description: Cancer patients, clinicians, and payers lack treatments with adequate efficacy, tolerability, and affordability.
concepts.qualityNote: Specific cancer feature; overlaps the broader therapy feature.

concepts.label: Climate-smart production and decarbonization
concepts.description: Agriculture and industrial systems struggle to reduce emissions, resource use, waste, and climate exposure while maintaining output.
concepts.qualityNote: Combines agricultural and industrial transition problems.

concepts.label: Financial access and livelihoods in emerging markets
concepts.description: Households, farmers, and small businesses in emerging markets lack affordable finance, reliable payments, market access, and income opportunities.
concepts.qualityNote: Partly geography-driven; interpret as a cross-cutting access feature.

concepts.label: Mobility and belonging for global young adults
concepts.description: Students, migrants, remote workers, and dispersed communities face friction building careers, accessing services, traveling, and sustaining belonging away from home.
concepts.qualityNote: Heterogeneous feature with India/diaspora language effects.

concepts.label: Organizational workflow and team coordination
concepts.description: Operational teams struggle with fragmented data, repetitive work, coordination, and timely decision-making.
concepts.qualityNote: Customer problem is coherent although many proposed solutions are software.

concepts.label: Living better with chronic and neurological conditions
concepts.description: People with chronic, neurological, or mental-health conditions and their caregivers lack effective support for function, independence, and quality of life.
concepts.qualityNote: Broad patient-quality-of-life feature.

concepts.label: Foundational learning and family–school support
concepts.description: Children, families, and schools struggle to build foundational skills and respond early when students fall behind.
concepts.qualityNote: Strongest activations emphasize younger learners.

concepts.label: Safer, faster clinical and technical operations
concepts.description: Frontline professionals face avoidable delays, failures, and complications in time-sensitive procedures and equipment-dependent work.
concepts.qualityNote: Mixed clinical/engineering feature; use cautiously.

concepts.label: Scaling data-intensive operations
concepts.description: Technical and operational teams struggle to deploy, maintain, and act on complex data systems reliably and efficiently.
concepts.qualityNote: Can drift toward solution/technology language; label states the organizational friction.

concepts.label: Rural health, nutrition, and water access
concepts.description: Rural and low-resource communities lack reliable access to basic health services, nutritious food, and safe water.
concepts.qualityNote: Moderately mixed but demand-side access theme is visible.

concepts.label: Sports participation, community, and fan connection
concepts.description: Athletes and fans lack inclusive participation, representation, connection, and viable community experiences around sports.
concepts.qualityNote: Includes fitness participation and sports media.

concepts.label: Independent storytelling and publishing
concepts.description: Writers and storytellers struggle to publish, reach readers, build community, and earn sustainable income.
concepts.qualityNote: Small primary area; monitor stability.

concepts.label: Clean energy access and electrification
concepts.description: Property owners, businesses, and infrastructure operators face cost and coordination barriers to reliable clean energy and electrification.
concepts.qualityNote: Strong demand-side energy transition theme.

concepts.label: Healthier and culturally relevant food
concepts.description: Consumers lack convenient food that fits health needs, cultural identity, taste, and everyday routines.
concepts.qualityNote: Includes medically appropriate and functional foods.

concepts.label: Creator audience and sustainable monetization
concepts.description: Independent creators struggle to understand, reach, retain, and earn income from their audiences.
concepts.qualityNote: Closely related to independent publishing.

concepts.label: Care navigation and clinical workflow
concepts.description: Patients, providers, and care organizations face fragmented information, navigation barriers, and inefficient daily workflows.
concepts.qualityNote: Contains some non-human-care outliers.

concepts.label: Hiring, scheduling, and workforce wellbeing
concepts.description: Employers and workers struggle with hiring, shift allocation, burnout, retention, and team performance.
concepts.qualityNote: Strong organizational customer-friction theme.

concepts.label: Social connection and meaningful relationships
concepts.description: People struggle to find friends, partners, shared experiences, and sustained connection across life transitions.
concepts.qualityNote: Coherent strongest activations.

concepts.label: Indian diaspora and urban consumer needs
concepts.description: Indian and diaspora consumers face fragmented services around mobility, lifestyle, identity, and life abroad.
concepts.qualityNote: Geography-driven and heterogeneous; not a preferred leadership taxonomy feature.

concepts.label: Farm productivity and agricultural waste
concepts.description: Farmers and agricultural partners face costly inputs, crop risk, waste, and weak access to actionable production support.
concepts.qualityNote: Coherent agricultural demand theme.

concepts.label: Industrial decarbonization and carbon markets
concepts.description: Heavy industry, energy producers, and carbon-market participants struggle to reduce, measure, and transact emissions credibly.
concepts.qualityNote: Strong climate/industry feature.

concepts.label: Diagnostics, biosamples, and health data
concepts.description: Patients, clinicians, and researchers face slow, costly, or incomplete diagnostic information and biosample data infrastructure.
concepts.qualityNote: Some text contains solution-specific language; reviewed as underlying information need.

concepts.label: Mental, cognitive, and neurological wellbeing
concepts.description: Patients, families, and care teams lack effective, accessible support for mental, cognitive, and neurological conditions.
concepts.qualityNote: Includes dementia, mental health, and neurological disease.

concepts.label: Urban leisure and diaspora services
concepts.description: Mobile urban consumers and diaspora communities face friction accessing leisure, dining, travel, and culturally relevant services.
concepts.qualityNote: Heterogeneous and partly geography/writing-style driven; interpret cautiously.

concepts.label: College and career navigation
concepts.description: Students and early-career workers lack guidance, experiential pathways, and employer connections for education-to-work transitions.
concepts.qualityNote: Broad postsecondary pathway feature.

concepts.label: Housing access and homeowner economics
concepts.description: Renters, buyers, homeowners, and landlords face affordability, flexibility, information, and transaction frictions in housing.
concepts.qualityNote: Includes accessory dwelling and rental-income needs.

concepts.label: Inclusive investing and household finance
concepts.description: Households and emerging investors lack accessible, trustworthy ways to save, invest, and build financial security.
concepts.qualityNote: Investment and savings feature.

concepts.label: Safer, more efficient hospital care
concepts.description: Patients, clinicians, hospitals, and payers face preventable complications, prolonged stays, and inefficient care delivery.
concepts.qualityNote: Broad hospital-level outcomes feature.

concepts.label: Kidney care and safe-water access
concepts.description: People face severe health consequences from inadequate kidney-disease management or unsafe water.
concepts.qualityNote: Conflates two distinct problems; small and not leadership-ready.

concepts.label: Opportunity and representation for excluded groups
concepts.description: Racially and culturally excluded communities lack representation, networks, career opportunity, and institutions that reflect their identities.
concepts.qualityNote: Includes Black, AAPI, immigrant, and other underrepresented groups.

concepts.label: International student mobility and career access
concepts.description: International students and globally mobile trainees face fragmented access to internships, rotations, networks, and employment pathways.
concepts.qualityNote: Specific global education-to-work feature.

concepts.label: Language learning and language-accessible services
concepts.description: Language learners and limited-proficiency users face barriers to confident communication and equitable access to services.
concepts.qualityNote: Coherent language-access feature.

concepts.label: Effective therapies for chronic and age-related disease
concepts.description: Patients with chronic, degenerative, or age-related conditions lack sufficiently effective and tolerable treatments.
concepts.qualityNote: Broad therapy feature; overlaps mental/neurological health.

concepts.label: Arts access and creative livelihoods
concepts.description: Artists and learners lack equitable access to arts education, audiences, fair compensation, and sustainable creative careers.
concepts.qualityNote: Strong creative-opportunity theme.

concepts.label: Safer, more effective cancer treatment
concepts.description: Cancer patients, clinicians, and payers lack treatments with adequate efficacy, tolerability, and affordability.
concepts.qualityNote: Specific, coherent HLS feature.

concepts.label: Women’s reproductive and life-stage health
concepts.description: Women and birthing people lack accessible, personalized support across reproductive health, pregnancy, postpartum, and menopause.
concepts.qualityNote: Strong demand-side women’s-health feature.

concepts.label: Financial and business access in African markets
concepts.description: Households, migrants, and businesses in African markets face gaps in finance, payments, logistics, and dependable services.
concepts.qualityNote: Geography-driven and cross-sector; interpret as an access feature.

concepts.label: College access and first-generation student support
concepts.description: First-generation and low-income students face counseling, affordability, belonging, and transition barriers in reaching and completing college.
concepts.qualityNote: More specific than the broader college/career feature.
